column5: Requires engineering-reference-model=1 and source-specimens-matched=0. This pack selects standard Grade 5, not the ELI Grade 23 or Ru-bearing Grade 29 variants. Source Celsius temperatures are used as printed. The sparse linear curves are calculation approximations, not interpolation-error bounds. Texture-dependent elastic ranges are not collapsed into a fictitious modulus. No strength, creep, fatigue, implant qualification or thermal-density law is claimed.
4.42 g/cm3 converts to 4420 kg/m3 at 295.15 K. A common coupon, lot and uncertainty are not supplied.
Conductivity is explicitly mill annealed. Knots are 20, 315 and 650 C. The exact mill-anneal schedule is not specified.
Printed J/(g K) values are multiplied by 1000. The source does not explicitly extend the conductivity's mill-annealed label to this separate property.
Printed micro-ohm metre values are multiplied by 1e-6. The source does not assign a heat-treatment schedule to this property.
